historical_withdrawal_notice_catalog.reason: Published A2 receiver could be reached from its parked dock with one shot; moving-world relationship not established by previous counter coverage. Dependent Map adapters also quarantined until independent expanded countersearch.

Eight same-geometry supplemental ray policies reach a safe stable rewarded exit and open the bell before the body falls below the claimed lip. The old low_ray_then_recoil_return_missing purpose tag does not invalidate these actual bypasses.

Fourteen audited no-hit policies on the old broad lower floor reach actual rewarded safe stable landing positions near the left edge. The original narrow goal center hid these physical alternatives, so the old version does not establish that enemy displacement is needed for the reward landing.

Five of eight entry-phase synchronization alternatives reach a safe stable rewarded exit without the claimed necessary aerial observation dwell. The old purpose checker rejects them only for no_safe_air_observation, so this exact version does not support its stronger causal claim.
Extended ordinary held jump reaches the hook without first spending the extra jump, refuting proposed refill dependency

The published exact witness was selected from the first held enemy phase instead of the clean/counter-tested phase fixed before holdout. Original base enemy cooldown is 0.6; published held clean-0 uses 0.4197450621205079. The original v2 protocol explicitly says not to publish the v1 versions. Their exact-phase counterexample certification is therefore invalid.
